newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer-Standard says managed its oper cost.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer-Standard says managed its oper cost.

text.p: Pioneer-Standard Electronics Inc said Wednesday it continues to see a weak pricing environment and a shift in product mix to lower-margin items throughout the industry.
It said it was able to offset these price and margin pressures in the first quarter by more efficiently managing its operating costs, which resulted in its rise in earnings.
The company also said the semiconductor market has shown some improvement during the quarter, reflecting the improving balance between supply and demand.
The company reported net income per share of $0.28 increased 4 percent from $0.27 for the same period a year ago.
Net income for was $7.3, up 19 percent from $6.2 million in the same year-ago period.
Due primarily to a stock issuance in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997, the first-quarter percentage increase in net income was significantly higher than that for net income per share.
